doc.brief: The status gives a rough indication of the completion of a running print operation.
doc.md:
The status gives a rough indication of the completion of a running
print operation.

finished.brief: The printing has been completed successfully.
finished.md: The printing has been completed successfully.

generating_data.brief: This status is set while the pages are being rendered.
generating_data.md:
This status is set while the
  pages are being rendered.

initial.brief: The printing has not started yet; this status is set initially, and while the print dialog is shown.
initial.md:
The printing has not started yet; this
  status is set initially, and while the print dialog is shown.

pending.brief: The print job has been sent to the printer, but is not printed for some reason, e.g. the printer may be stopped.
pending.md:
The print job has been sent to the printer,
  but is not printed for some reason, e.g. the printer may be stopped.

pending_issue.brief: Some problem has occurred during printing, e.g. a paper jam.
pending_issue.md:
Some problem has occurred during
  printing, e.g. a paper jam.

preparing.brief: This status is set while the begin-print signal is emitted and during pagination.
preparing.md:
This status is set while the begin-print
  signal is emitted and during pagination.

printing.brief: The printer is processing the print job.
printing.md: The printer is processing the print job.

sending_data.brief: The print job is being sent off to the printer.
sending_data.md:
The print job is being sent off to the
  printer.
